title: Uttarakhand minister Rekha Arya posts video after FIR: 'Husband hid first marriage, had affairs,... - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
Uttarakhand cabinet minister Rekha Arya has filed an FIR against her husband, Girdhari Lal Sahu, accusing him of physical assault, harassment, using casteist slurs and threatening to kill her.
The FIR was registered on October 15 at the Cantt police station in Dehradun under relevant sections of law, including three sections of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
In her complaint, Arya, a minister in the state’s BJP government, said she belongs to a Scheduled Caste and that Sahu had known this from the start. She alleged that Sahu deceived her at the time of their marriage by claiming he was unmarried.
“A few years later, I discovered the truth: he was already married and had children from a previous marriage. By then, however, we had children of our own; following the counsel of family members—and for the sake of our children’s future—I chose to remain silent,” the FIR states.
Allegations of affairs, assault and threats
Arya also alleged that Sahu is “maintaining illicit relationships with other women.”
“When I objected, he initially acknowledged his wrongdoing and offered both a written and verbal apology; however, he continued to engage in such conduct even after these apologies. When I opposed these relationships, Girdhari Lal Sahu began subjecting me to physical assault and verbal abuse, and even threatened to kill me,” the FIR says.
She further said she had recently come across an audio recording in which Sahu can allegedly be heard conspiring with a woman to kill her.
Minister shares audio, urges women to speak up
After filing the FIR, Arya posted a video along with the audio recording on social media. She said she decided to go to the police after hearing the recording, and that she did so to protect her children.
Urging women to speak out against domestic abuse, Arya said, “Whether a woman is ordinary or prominent—domestic abuse should not be endured; one must speak up against it.”
Her health has since deteriorated, and she is currently admitted to a hospital.
